lead.text: Review the Privacy Policy of Zedgehost. Learn how we securely collect, use, and protect your personal and website data across all our hosting services.

content.text: At Zedgehost ("we", "our", or "us"), your privacy is our top priority. We are committed to protecting your personal information and ensuring that your web hosting, domain registration, and cloud services experience is secure. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your data when you visit zedgehost.com or use our hosting services.
When you sign up for Zedgehost web hosting or domain services, we may collect the following information:

items.text: Name, email address, phone number, and billing address.
Credit card details, PayPal, or local payment gateways (e.g., JazzCash, EasyPaisa, Bank Transfer) used for purchasing our services.
IP addresses, browser types, and usage data to help us optimize server performance and troubleshoot issues on your VPS or shared hosting accounts.

content.text: Zedgehost uses the collected data to:

items.text: Provision and manage your web hosting, domain, and server accounts.
Process payments and send billing notices.
Provide 24/7 technical support and customer service.
Enhance our server security and prevent fraudulent activities.
Send you important updates regarding server maintenance or Zedgehost promotional offers.

content.text: Zedgehost employs industry-standard security measures, including SSL encryption, DDoS protection, and regular server backups, to protect your personal and website data against unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction. We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.

You have the right to access, update, or request the deletion of your personal data stored with Zedgehost. You can manage your account details via the Zedgehost Client Area. For any privacy-related queries, you can contact our support team.

Zedgehost reserves the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. Any changes will be posted on this page, and your continued use of Zedgehost services constitutes your acceptance of the revised policy.
